R code loads DBI, boot, collapse, data.table, dplyr, duckdb, fixest, fst, ggplot2, glue, gridExtra, gtsummary, haven, here, kableExtra, lubridate, modelsummary, pacman, pbapply, readr, readxl, rmarkdown, stringr, survey, tableone, tidyverse, vroom, vtable, xtable, zctaCrosswalk with no renv.lock. A rerun installs current CRAN versions and must log them.

1 file reads use paths built at run time (macros, globs, variables), so triage could not check that those inputs exist.
No licence file and no licence named in the documentation. Running it for a check is unaffected, but a receipt should quote and hash files rather than redistribute them.
